title: `donateAndClaim()` will not work for remote donate and claim
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Users can utilize `donateAndClaim()` to make a donation in native token via `msg.value` and then perform a ZRO claim.
